attempts.thought: The sets create a balanced offense-defense core: Mega Garchomp and Life Orb Metagross provide heavy physical pressure, while Choice Scarf Dragapult offers immediate special speed and pivoting. Arcanine’s Intimidate and Will-O-Wisp support the team, and Rotom-Wash’s defensive spread with Hex and Pain Split forms a sturdy pivot. Toxapex with Focus Sash and Regenerator reliably sets Toxic Spikes and stalls with Haze and Baneful Bunker, completing the stall backbone.
